question: Buhsu Jiba is a festival celebrated in the state of ________.
solution:
The correct answer is: '**__Nagaland__'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Kachari tribes **are mainly found in the **Dimapur district of Nagaland**.
 
• The **Bushu **is basically a post** harvest festival **and usually falls in the month of **January** every year after all the hard earned grains of paddy are harvested, thrashed and stored in the granaries.
 
• The exact date and place of the festival is not generally fixed, people see to it that it is celebrated when there is moonlight in the nights because it is believed to be auspicious.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Bushu is celebrated either village-wise or sometimes a number of villages in contiguous area together organise the festival. 
 
• The food items of the festival include rice, mutton, chicken, pork, buffalo meat and rice beer. 
 
• The killing of these animals is known as ‘Meesthaiba’ which involves ritualistic performance before the animals are actually killed.
